name: Adrian Fontes
summary: Adrian Paulino Fontes (born April 3, 1970) is an American politician and attorney serving as the Secretary of State of Arizona since 2023. He previously served as the Maricopa County Recorder from 2017 to 2021. He is a member of the Democratic Party.
